summary.intent: Fix the vault recovery E2E test failing in CI, resolve Grafana dashboard provisioning errors in staging deployments, fix writable-shares E2E test failures, and update codebase documentation to reflect the current multi-package/crate architecture.
summary.outcome: All issues resolved: vault recovery E2E fixed (protobuf field bug + resolution order), Grafana API key regenerated, desktop build signing keys wired into CI, writable-shares E2E fixed (IPNS key lookup fallback), codebase docs rewritten across all 7 files, and throttle limits relaxed in test mode to enable full local E2E runs.

repo: IPNS record protobuf field layout: value is field 1, signatureV1 is field 2 — recovery.html previously used fieldNumber === 2 when it should have been fieldNumber === 1
resolveIpns() tried IPFS gateway HEAD first (15s timeout) before delegated routing — in CI, Kubo can't resolve mock-published IPNS names, causing every resolution to waste 15s
Standalone file shares store the file-ipns key with itemId = fileId (real UUID), but SharedFileBrowser creates a synthetic FilePointer with id = shareId, causing IPNS key lookup mismatch
ThrottlerModule limits are hardcoded (100/min) — NODE_ENV=test alone didn't relax them; required forRootAsync with environment check to get 200/sec + 2000/min in test
The BypassableThrottlerGuard supports X-Throttle-Bypass header for SDK tests but browser E2E tests can't use it
Tauri updater pubkey was added to tauri.conf.json but TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY was never wired into any of the 3 desktop build jobs in deploy-staging.yml
Grafana Cloud /api/health returns 404 (not 401/403) when the Bearer token is invalid or expired — can be mistaken for URL misconfiguration
mock-ipns-routing stores IPNS records in memory; after worktree cleanup the phase-20 debug session context was invalidated

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord() was checking fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value) when parsing IPNS protobuf response
Fetch retry backoff only triggered on thrown errors, not on non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx) — added !resp.ok check
resp.json() was called first then resp.arrayBuffer() in fallthrough — double body consumption bug; fixed by wrapping protobuf parse in else branch
getFileIpnsKeyFn fallback added: if exact itemId match fails AND shareItem.share.itemType === 'file', use first file-ipns key — safe for standalone file shares with single file
ThrottlerModule converted to forRootAsync to support environment-based limit override: 200/sec + 2000/min when NODE_ENV=test
Test 10.3 failed because textarea.fill() triggers React onChange asynchronously — Ctrl+S fired before isDirty was true; fix was to wait for modified status indicator before keypress
Shared RECOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS constant added so test timeout and assertion timeout stay in sync

workflow: Run web E2E tests locally with API in NODE_ENV=test before pushing — prevents throttle interference and round-tripping to CI
When IPFS/IPNS is involved, delegated routing should always be tried before direct IPFS gateway — gateway can hang 15-30s when Kubo can't resolve names
Grafana dashboard provisioning needs a Service Account token (Editor role), not a Loki/Prometheus data source API key
Killing Playwright processes also kills the web dev server on port 5173 — need to restart after forceful cleanup
Running multiple Playwright suites in parallel against shared API/DB/mock-ipns causes test interference — always run in isolation or full sequential suite
Codebase docs in .planning/codebase/ can be regenerated in parallel using 3 specialized mapper agents to cover tech stack, architecture/structure, and testing/concerns

friction: Multiple CI round-trips before discovering the root cause of writable-shares failure was IPNS key ID mismatch — test should have been run locally first
Parallel E2E test runs (background task + foreground run) caused test interference and confusing results before root cause was identified
NODE_ENV=test didn't actually relax throttle limits — required a code change; this caused 6 test failures in the first full suite run that looked like account creation bugs
Worktree cleanup invalidated a debug session (vault-migration-iife-silent-failure) that was waiting for human verification in a now-deleted worktree
Grafana Cloud returns 404 instead of 401/403 for invalid API tokens, making it look like a URL configuration issue rather than an auth issue
The fix for stale closure in test 10.3 (waiting for modified indicator) turned out not to be the root cause — the real issue was the IPNS key lookup mismatch in app code
Markdownlint failures blocked codebase doc commit — underscore emphasis footers and bare code fences across multiple generated files required additional cleanup pass
open_items: docs/milestone-v1.1-completion branch has codebase doc updates committed but not yet PRed or merged

Full web E2E suite has 3 local-only failures: recycle-bin TC01 (login timing), mfa-flows TC-MFA-01 (Web3Auth MFA infrastructure), full-workflow 6.5.4 (CID refresh timing) — these pass in CI but should be investigated
PR #376 (writable-shares IPNS key fix) not yet merged — waiting on CI confirmation
6 pending todos flagged in progress check — not reviewed
